Bhutan Overland Adventure

Experience the magic of the Thunder Dragon Kingdom on this incredible self-drive journey through Bhutan.

10 Days
Moderate
₹2,90,500 per person (Double Sharing)
Room Occupancy & Pricing Policy: Prices shared across all expeditions are per person on a double-sharing basis (2 persons sharing 1 room). In case you prefer single occupancy (no room sharing), the price will be 2x (doubled).

Overview

Embark on an unforgettable journey through the mystical Kingdom of Bhutan. This overland adventure takes you through pristine valleys, ancient monasteries, and stunning mountain passes. Experience the unique Bhutanese culture, witness the iconic Tiger's Nest Monastery, and drive through some of the most scenic landscapes in the Himalayas.

Highlights

Visit the iconic Tiger's Nest Monastery
Explore Punakha Dzong and Paro Valley
Drive through Dochula Pass with panoramic Himalayan views
Experience authentic Bhutanese culture and cuisine
Self-drive through stunning mountain landscapes
Visit ancient fortresses and monasteries

What's Included

Professional guide and support vehicle
Accommodation in boutique hotels
All meals and permits
4x4 vehicle rental
Entry fees to all attractions
Cultural experiences and activities

Detailed Itinerary

1

Arrival in Paro

Arrive in Paro, pick up your 4x4 vehicle, and acclimatize. Evening orientation and welcome dinner.

2

Paro to Thimphu

Drive to Thimphu, visit the National Memorial Chorten, and explore the capital city.

3

Thimphu Exploration

Visit Buddha Dordenma, Tashichho Dzong, and local markets. Experience Bhutanese culture.

4

Thimphu to Punakha

Cross Dochula Pass and drive to Punakha. Visit the magnificent Punakha Dzong.

5

Punakha Valley

Explore Punakha Valley, visit Chimi Lhakhang, and enjoy riverside activities.

6

Punakha to Paro

Drive back to Paro via scenic mountain roads. Free evening in Paro town.

7

Tiger's Nest Monastery

Hike to the iconic Tiger's Nest Monastery (Taktsang). Afternoon at leisure.

8

Paro Valley Exploration

Visit Rinpung Dzong, National Museum, and explore Paro Valley.

9

Haa Valley Day Trip

Day trip to the beautiful Haa Valley, one of Bhutan's hidden gems.

10

Departure

Final breakfast and departure from Paro International Airport.
